speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Where did it go wrong?
A lot of things went wrong ,  starting with decisions that I made.
Can you expand on that?
It’s not easy to expand, so I just ask for  a bit of respect if I don't go too much  
into it. The game plan didn’t work out. I’m  very honest. If the game plan didn’t work  
out the way you wanted it to work out,  its because you didn’t decide it well.
You said before the game that this was a special  
game, not like any other, do you think the  players realised that in the first half?
Alasdair, I will not judge my players  in front of you. I refuse to do that.
Were there signs of something  to take from the second half?
Yeah, in the second half, but we've been  in football too long to realise that  
the positives from a second half in this game  are almost lost. This thought that if we achieve  
a goal early in the second half maybe we then  can react and go for it. It didn't happen, but  
all the positives are very fragile in  terms of analysis that we should do.
Where do you go from here? Is it back to the  drawing board with your tactics and formation?
Maybe. First of all we have to recover mentally  and physically for the next one. Then we have to  
make better decisions, work harder and find the  right decision. We started very well with a clear  
idea we lost it. We must assume and realise  we lost it. It is taking us too much time to  
go back to the things we want to do and  the things we want to become as a team.
We want to be a team that is fast, stronger,  
solid, dominant. We are not being that team.  This is how me and my coaching staff work.  
First recover the players mentally and physically  find them help them find the right solutions  
for them to develop better the  way we want to play football.
Are you satisfied that the players are  responding to your methods and tactics in games?
Not today.
Why?
I just mentioned to you, how can  I be happy on a day like this?
I mean why didn’t they respond to your tactics?
Because I decided bad. I decided bad. Didn’t  
make the right decisions. And I refuse to go  much further than that. It’s my responsibility.  
All I have to say, I’ll say it to the players  among us. Because us must solve the problem.
You've been very honest but that might be worrying  for the fans, do you have a message for them?
Of course, I have a message. A message that  we’re disappointed because today was a special  
game for all of us, for our fans, and we didn’t  achieve the standards that our fans deserve.
So my message is I  
promise we’ll try to fix it. The only message  we can say by words. After that it’s work. What  
I expect, what I want is a totally  different game in the next one.
title: Nuno  "We Didn't Achieve Standards Our Fans Deserve" | Arsenal 3-1 Tottenham | Press Conference
